detail.body:
## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [ ] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [ ] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL (Block-Sparse Attention), plus benchmarks and docs.

## Summary

Adds a **KPage** (page-compacted) path to Block-Sparse Attention for SM100/SM103, blk128, forward and backward.

`kpage=True` (or a prepared `KPageLayout`) on `block_sparse_attention_forward` / `block_sparse_attention_backward` selects kernels that split every selected K/V block into 16-row pages and gather only the valid pages, from any blocks, into the 128-row MMA tile during the TMA load. A block with `v` valid rows then costs `16 * ceil(v / 16)` rows instead of 128.

- **Forward:** new `bsa_fwd_sm100_kpage.py` (M128 x N128) and `bsa_fwd_sm100_kpage_q64.py` (M64 x N256, used for query blocks with at most 64 valid rows), derived from the blk128 / blk64 forward kernels.
- **Backward:** new `bsa_bwd_sm100_kpage.py`, derived from the blk128 backward. K/V pages are packed into owner tiles and the kernel walks the union of their Q pages with a per-step page-pair mask, so `block_sizes` is supported in backward on this path.
- **Masked rows:** handled without touching the compute loop (kv rows in-kernel, q rows through `LSE = +inf` / `dPsum = 0`), so masked rows of q/k/v/do only have to be finite, as for the base kernels.
- **Metadata:** page tables, keep masks, work queues and backward owner tiles are built by CuTe DSL kernels under `block_sparse_attention/kpage/` and can be reused across calls via `kpage_prepare_layout()`.
- **Query-side padding:** `kpage_prepare_layout(q_block_sizes=...)` marks padding on the query side. Those rows are not computed and their `o` / `lse` / `dq` rows are written as zero.
- **Benchmark:** `benchmark/bsa/benchmark_sm100_kpage.py` rebuilds blk128 layouts from the released geometry of HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA, Sliding Tile Attention and FastVideo VSA, and compares the base path with kpage.
- **Docs / licensing:** `docs/fe-oss-apis/bsa.md` documents the contract; `LICENSING.md` lists the two new derived files.

With the same arguments the KPage path computes the same function as the base kernels (`block_sizes` masks keys, every query row is valid).

## Why

In 3D video layouts, `block_sizes` leaves many selected blocks only partially occupied. The base kernels still pay for a full 128-row tile per selected block. Compacting valid 16-row pages into the MMA tile removes that wasted work. Measured speedup on SM103 is 1.10-3.8x forward on the benchmark layouts above (CuTe DSL 4.8.0, B300).

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

- Opt-in and additive: new `kpage` argument (appended, with default) on the forward/backward entry points, plus new exports `KPageLayout` and `kpage_prepare_layout`. The default path is unchanged.
- Contract: BF16, head_dim 128, MHA/GQA/MQA, BHSD or BSHD, independent `seqlen_q` / `seqlen_k`; a batch runs as `batch * heads`; `allow_empty_block_nums` behaves as on the base path.
- Targets SM100/SM103.

## Testing

- New tests in `test/python/block_sparse_attention/cutedsl/test_BSA_kpage.py`: `pytest -m L0 --noconftest test_BSA_kpage.py` on B300 (SM103) with CuTe DSL 4.8.0, 28 passed. `test_kpage_seqlen_not_multiple_of_128` also covers `seqlen_q=1050` with 2 heads, whose 26-row tail takes the M64 x N256 route; without the scheduler-stride fix in `bsa_fwd_sm100_kpage_q64.py` it fails with an illegal memory access. `test_kpage_empty_query_blocks_ignore_stale_tmem` poisons the tensor memory with NaN before an M64 forward that has empty query blocks.
- After rebasing onto `develop`, on B300 (SM103) with CuTe DSL 4.8.0 (the current `pyproject.toml` floor): `python benchmark/bsa/benchmark_sm100_kpage.py --check` passes the fp32 spot checks (O and dQ max abs error about 4e-4 or lower, padded query rows exactly zero), and the full 8-layout run gives 1.10-3.8x forward and 1.03-2.2x forward+backward over the base path with the same `block_sizes`.
- `compute-sanitizer --tool synccheck` on the M128 and M64 forward and on the backward (full, partially occupied and <= 64-row blocks, BHSD, H=2, `seqlen_q=1050`): 0 errors; `memcheck` on the `seqlen_q=1050` forward: no kernel-level errors. The base blk128 forward reports 0 errors as well.
- Earlier runs by the original author: SM103 with CuTe DSL 4.6.2, 4.7.0 and 4.7.1.
- `pre-commit` has not been run; `black -l 160` was applied to the new benchmark files.

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+# BSA benchmarks
+
+| Script | What it measures |
+| --- | --- |
+| `benchmark_sm90_blk128.py` | SM90: native blk128 vs. the same sparse graph expressed in blk64 |
+| `benchmark_sm120_blk128.py` | SM120: native blk128 BF16 forward |
+| `benchmark_sm100_kpage.py` | SM100/SM103: blk128 BSA with and without `kpage` on layouts from open-source video sparse-attention systems |
+
+## `benchmark_sm100_kpage.py`
+
+`kpage_layouts.py` provides blk128 sparse layouts of three open-source video
+sparse-attention systems: HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA, Sliding Tile Attention and
+FastVideo VSA. They are rebuilt from the released tile geometry, padding rule,
+resolution and frame count; block occupancy does not depend on sample
+content, so no data files are needed. Q/K/V are synthetic (random normal) in
+every case.
+`kpage_layouts.BENCHMARK_LAYOUTS` lists the eight default layouts:
+
+| layout | system | configuration | heads x tokens | what makes blocks partial |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `ssta_hy15_480p_121f` | HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA | 848x480, 121 frames: latent 31x30x53 in (6,8,8) tiles; per head a (3,3,3) tile window plus top-32 tiles; 356 text tokens | 16 x 55168 | a full tile is 384 tokens = 3 blocks; boundary tiles and the text tokens end in partial blocks (10% padding) |
+| `ssta_hy15_480p_241f` | HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA | 848x480, 241 frames, window + top-64 | 16 x 106368 | as above (8.5%) |
+| `ssta_hy15_720p_121f` | HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA | 1280x720, 121 frames, window + top-32 | 16 x 116864 | as above (4.2%) |
+| `ssta_hy15_720p_241f` | HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA | 1280x720, 241 frames, window + top-64 | 16 x 225664 | as above (2.5%) |
+| `sta_hy_720p_117f` | Sliding Tile Attention | 1280x720, 117 frames, per-head windows of the HunyuanVideo mask search, 256 text tokens | 24 x 109056 | tile-aligned in time: only the spatial boundary and the text tokens are partial (0.7%), the near-dense regime |
+| `vsa_wan_480p_81f_t64` | FastVideo VSA on Wan2.1 | 832x480, 81 frames, (4,4,4) cubes of 64 tokens, sparsity 0.875 | 12 x 79872 | every cube gets its own block, so every block is at most half full (59%); all query blocks take the M64 x N256 route |
+| `vsa_wan_720p_81f_t256` | FastVideo VSA on Wan2.1 | 1280x720, 81 frames, (4,8,8) cubes of 256 tokens | 40 x 84480 | a full cube is 2 blocks; boundary cubes are partial (10.5%) |
+| `vsa_wan_720p_81f_t64` | FastVideo VSA on Wan2.1 | 1280x720, 81 frames, (4,4,4) cubes | 40 x 184320 | as the 480p (4,4,4) layout, 2.3x more tokens (59%) |
+
+All of these pad every tile on the query side as well as on the key side, so
+the KPage layout is built with `kpage_prepare_layout(..., q_block_sizes=...)`;
+the base path has no query-side padding and computes those rows.
+
+```bash
+cd benchmark/bsa
+python benchmark_sm100_kpage.py --check                       # eight layouts, fp32 spot checks
+python benchmark_sm100_kpage.py --layouts vsa:832x480x81:64:0.875:12 --iters 20
+```
+
+Columns: `pad%` is the fraction of padding rows after blk128 placement
+(query / key when the partitions differ), `part%` the fraction of nonempty KV
+blocks that are not full, `x` the base-BSA / KPage time ratio. Both paths
+run with the same `block_sizes`; the base path has no query-side padding and
+computes those rows. `--check` compares O (both paths) and dQ (KPage) of sampled query
+blocks against an fp32 reference.
+
+One run on an SM103 GPU (148 SMs, CUDA 13.2, PyTorch 2.12.0a0, CuTe DSL 4.8.0, 10 iterations after 3 warmups and a one-second clock warm-up):
+
+| layout | tokens | H | pad% | part% | BSA fwd ms | KPage fwd ms | x | BSA f+b ms | KPage f+b ms | x |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| ssta_hy15_480p_121f | 55168 | 16 | 10.0 | 18.3 | 6.28 | 4.94 | 1.27 | 24.81 | 21.81 | 1.14 |
+| ssta_hy15_480p_241f | 106368 | 16 | 8.5 | 15.5 | 21.83 | 19.01 | 1.15 | 79.76 | 73.11 | 1.09 |
+| ssta_hy15_720p_121f | 116864 | 16 | 4.2 | 12.2 | 16.09 | 14.14 | 1.14 | 58.48 | 56.84 | 1.03 |
+| ssta_hy15_720p_241f | 225664 | 16 | 2.5 | 9.1 | 54.14 | 47.69 | 1.14 | 194.31 | 180.09 | 1.08 |
+| sta_hy_720p_117f | 109056 | 24 | 0.7 | 5.9 | 57.82 | 52.52 | 1.10 | 208.76 | 201.82 | 1.03 |
+| vsa_wan_480p_81f_t64 | 79872 | 12 | 59.0 | 100.0 | 4.08 | 1.27 | 3.23 | 12.98 | 6.11 | 2.13 |
+| vsa_wan_720p_81f_t256 | 84480 | 40 | 10.5 | 16.7 | 14.85 | 12.50 | 1.19 | 55.41 | 52.07 | 1.06 |
+| vsa_wan_720p_81f_t64 | 184320 | 40 | 59.0 | 100.0 | 71.67 | 18.78 | 3.82 | 222.82 | 101.12 | 2.20 |
+
+`tokens` is the padded sequence length.

@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""SM100/SM103 blk128 BSA with and without kpage on layouts from open-source
+video sparse-attention systems (see kpage_layouts.py).
+
+    python benchmark_sm100_kpage.py                      # the eight layouts of kpage_layouts.BENCHMARK_LAYOUTS
+    python benchmark_sm100_kpage.py --layouts ssta:1280x720x121:16 vsa:832x480x81:64:0.875:12 --check
+
+Timings are CUDA-event medians of the attention call only; the kpage layout
+is built once outside the timed region (its build time is reported
+separately).  The video layouts pad every 3-D tile on both the
+query and the key side, so the layout is built with q_block_sizes (padding
+query rows are skipped and written as zero); the base path has no query-side
+padding and computes those rows.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.metadata
+import json
+import math
+import statistics
+import time
+
+import torch
+from cudnn import BSA
+
+import kpage_layouts
+
+BLOCK = 128
+
+
+def event_ms(fn, iters, warmup):
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        fn()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    times = []
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        start, end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True), torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        start.record()
+        fn()
+        end.record()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        times.append(start.elapsed_time(end))
+    return statistics.median(times)
+
+
+def warm_up_gpu(seconds=1.0):
+    """Bring the clocks up before the first timed layout (a cold GPU makes the first rows a few percent slow)."""
+    a = torch.randn(8192, 8192, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    end = time.perf_counter() + seconds
+    while time.perf_counter() < end:
+        a = a @ a
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+
+def _valid_rows(sizes):
+    return (torch.arange(BLOCK, device="cuda").view(1, BLOCK) < sizes.view(-1, 1)).reshape(-1)
+
+
+def make_inputs(layout, gen):
+    """q/do over the query partition, k/v over the KV partition; padding rows take no part (any finite value would do)."""
+    q_valid, kv_valid = _valid_rows(layout.q_sizes), _valid_rows(layout.block_sizes)
+    tensors = []
+    for seqlen, valid in ((layout.T, q_valid), (layout.seqlen_k, kv_valid), (layout.seqlen_k, kv_valid), (layout.T, q_valid)):
+        t = torch.randn((1, layout.H, seqlen, 128), generator=gen).to(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
+        t[0, :, ~valid] = 0
+        tensors.append(t)
+    return tensors, q_valid
+
+
+def sampled_reference(layout, q, k, v, do, blocks, head):
+    """fp32 O and dQ for a few query blocks of one head (full rows of K/V they attend)."""
+    outs, dqs, rows = [], [], []
+    bs, qs = layout.block_sizes.tolist(), layout.q_sizes.tolist()
+    for qb in blocks:
+        cnt = int(layout.q2k_cnt[0, head, qb])
+        kv_rows = torch.cat([torch.arange(j * BLOCK, j * BLOCK + bs[j], device="cuda") for j in layout.q2k_idx[0, head, qb, :cnt].tolist()])
+        q_rows = torch.arange(qb * BLOCK, qb * BLOCK + qs[qb], device="cuda")
+        q_blk = q[0, head, q_rows].float().detach().requires_grad_()
+        s = q_blk @ k[0, head, kv_rows].float().T / math.sqrt(128)
+        o = torch.softmax(s, -1) @ v[0, head, kv_rows].float()
+        o.backward(do[0, head, q_rows].float())
+        outs.append(o.detach())
+        dqs.append(q_blk.grad)
+        rows.append(q_rows)
+    return torch.cat(outs), torch.cat(dqs), torch.cat(rows)
+
+
+def run(layout, spec, args, gen):
+    layout = layout.to("cuda")
+    stats = layout.stats()
+    (q, k, v, do), valid = make_inputs(layout, gen)
+    idx, cnt, bs = layout.q2k_idx, layout.q2k_cnt, layout.block_sizes
+    with_bwd = not args.no_bwd
+    rec = dict(
+        layout=layout.name,
+        spec=spec,
+        desc=layout.desc,
+        heads=layout.H,
+        tokens=layout.T,  # padded length
+        **{key: stats[key] for key in ("H", "T", "seqlen_k", "nQ", "nB", "pad_frac_blk128", "q_pad_frac_blk128", "partial_block_frac", "useful_tflop_fwd")},
+    )
+
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    page_layout = BSA.kpage_prepare_layout(idx, None, bs, cnt, q_block_sizes=layout.q_sizes)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    rec["kpage_layout_build_ms"] = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3
+
+    base_fwd = lambda: BSA.block_sparse_attention_forward(q, k, v, idx, None, bs, cnt)
+    kpage_fwd = lambda: BSA.block_sparse_attention_forward(q, k, v, idx, None, bs, cnt, kpage=page_layout)
+    rec["bsa_fwd_ms"] = event_ms(base_fwd, args.iters, args.warmup)
+    rec["kpage_fwd_ms"] = event_ms(kpage_fwd, args.iters, args.warmup)
+    rec["fwd_speedup"] = rec["bsa_fwd_ms"] / rec["kpage_fwd_ms"]
+
+    if with_bwd:
+        o, lse = kpage_fwd()
+        kpage_bwd = lambda: BSA.block_sparse_attention_backward(do, q, k, v, o, lse, idx, None, bs, cnt, kpage=page_layout)
+        rec["kpage_bwd_ms"] = event_ms(kpage_bwd, args.iters, args.warmup)
+        ob, lseb = base_fwd()
+        base_bwd = lambda: BSA.block_sparse_attention_backward(do, q, k, v, ob, lseb, idx, None, bs, cnt)
+        rec["bsa_bwd_ms"] = event_ms(base_bwd, args.iters, args.warmup)
+        rec["fwd_bwd_speedup"] = (rec["bsa_fwd_ms"] + rec["bsa_bwd_ms"]) / (rec["kpage_fwd_ms"] + rec["kpage_bwd_ms"])
+
+    if args.check:
+        o_base = base_fwd()["o_tensor"]
+        o_kp, lse_kp = kpage_fwd()
+        blocks = torch.linspace(0, layout.nQ - 1, steps=min(4, layout.nQ)).round().long().tolist()
+        o_ref, dq_ref, rows = sampled_reference(layout, q, k, v, do, blocks, head=0)
+        rec["check"] = dict(
+            kpage_o_max_abs_err=(o_kp[0, 0, rows].float() - o_ref).abs().max().item(),
+            bsa_o_max_abs_err=(o_base[0, 0, rows].float() - o_ref).abs().max().item(),
+            kpage_vs_bsa_o_max_abs_diff=(o_kp[0, :, valid].float() - o_base[0, :, valid].float()).abs().max().item(),
+            kpage_pad_rows_zero=bool((o_kp[0, :, ~valid] == 0).all()),
+        )
+        if with_bwd:
+            dq = BSA.block_sparse_attention_backward(do, q, k, v, o_kp, lse_kp, idx, None, bs, cnt, kpage=page_layout)["dq_tensor"]
+            rec["check"]["kpage_dq_max_abs_err"] = (dq[0, 0, rows].float() - dq_ref).abs().max().item()
+    return rec
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
+    parser.add_argument("--layouts", nargs="*", default=kpage_layouts.BENCHMARK_LAYOUTS)
+    parser.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=3)
+    parser.add_argument("--no-bwd", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="compare O and dQ of sampled query blocks against an fp32 reference")
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", default="/tmp/bsa-sm100-kpage.json")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    major, _ = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    assert major == 10, "kpage requires an SM100/SM103 GPU"
+
+    report = dict(
+        gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),

+"""blk128 sparse layouts from open-source video sparse-attention systems.
+
+For the tile-based systems block occupancy follows the released tile
+geometry, padding rule, resolution, and frame count and does not depend on
+sample content, so those layouts are generated here.  Q/K/V are synthetic in
+every case.
+
+* ``ssta_hunyuan``: HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA (hunyuanvideo_1_5_transformer.py
+  attn_param): (6,8,8) latent tiles, zero padding, (3,3,3) sliding window OR
+  per-head top-k, text tokens appended.
+* ``sta_hunyuan``: Sliding Tile Attention with the per-head windows of the
+  HunyuanVideo mask search, no top-k.
+* ``vsa_wan``: FastVideo Video Sparse Attention on a Wan2.1 latent: (4,4,4) or
+  (4,8,8) cubes, ``construct_variable_block_sizes`` padding, top-k cubes per
+  query cube at the given sparsity (random scores).
+
+Every logical tile or cluster with ``v`` valid tokens becomes ``ceil(v / 128)``
+blk128 blocks (full blocks first, then one partial block), and tile adjacency
+is expanded to block adjacency.  Pad tokens never take part in the attention.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+BLOCK = 128
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Layout:
+    """One sparse pattern.  ``block_sizes`` is the KV partition; ``q_block_sizes``
+    the query partition (``None``: the two sides share ``block_sizes``)."""
+
+    name: str
+    desc: str
+    H: int
+    q2k_idx: torch.Tensor  # [1, H, nQ, kmax] int32
+    q2k_cnt: torch.Tensor  # [1, H, nQ] int32
+    block_sizes: torch.Tensor  # [nKV] int32
+    meta: Dict = field(default_factory=dict)
+    q_block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None  # [nQ] int32
+
+    @property
+    def nB(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.block_sizes.shape[0])
+
+    @property
+    def nQ(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.q2k_cnt.shape[-1])
+
+    @property
+    def T(self) -> int:
+        return self.nQ * BLOCK
+
+    @property
+    def seqlen_k(self) -> int:
+        return self.nB * BLOCK
+
+    @property
+    def q_sizes(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.block_sizes if self.q_block_sizes is None else self.q_block_sizes
+
+    @property
+    def independent(self) -> bool:
+        return self.q_block_sizes is not None
+
+    def to(self, device) -> "Layout":
+        qbs = None if self.q_block_sizes is None else self.q_block_sizes.to(device)
+        return Layout(self.name, self.desc, self.H, self.q2k_idx.to(device), self.q2k_cnt.to(device), self.block_sizes.to(device), dict(self.meta), qbs)
+
+    def stats(self) -> Dict:
+        bs = self.block_sizes.to(torch.int64).cpu()
+        qs = self.q_sizes.to(torch.int64).cpu()
+        idx = self.q2k_idx.to(torch.int64).cpu()
+        cnt = self.q2k_cnt.to(torch.int64).cpu()
+        H, nQ, kmax = idx.shape[1], idx.shape[2], idx.shape[3]
+        nB = self.nB
+        active = torch.arange(kmax).view(1, 1, 1, kmax) < cnt.unsqueeze(-1)
+        kv_rows_per_q = (bs[idx.clamp(0, nB - 1)] * active).sum(-1)
+        useful_pairs = int((kv_rows_per_q * qs.view(1, 1, nQ)).sum())
+        whole_pairs = int(cnt.sum()) * BLOCK * BLOCK
+        return dict(
+            H=H,
+            nB=nB,
+            nQ=nQ,
+            T=self.T,
+            seqlen_k=self.seqlen_k,
+            kmax=kmax,
+            independent_partitions=self.independent,
+            pad_frac_blk128=1.0 - int(bs.sum()) / self.seqlen_k,
+            q_pad_frac_blk128=1.0 - int(qs.sum()) / self.T,
+            partial_block_frac=int(((bs > 0) & (bs < BLOCK)).sum()) / nB,
+            q_partial_block_frac=int(((qs > 0) & (qs < BLOCK)).sum()) / nQ,
+            selected_block_pairs=int(cnt.sum()),
+            useful_pairs=useful_pairs,
+            whole_block_pairs=whole_pairs,
+            pair_efficiency=useful_pairs / max(whole_pairs, 1),
+            useful_tflop_fwd=4.0 * useful_pairs * 128 / 1e12,
+        )
+
+
+def _adj_to_q2k(adj: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """[H, nB, nB] bool -> padded (idx [1,H,nB,kmax], cnt [1,H,nB])."""
+    H, nQ, nK = adj.shape
+    cnt = adj.sum(-1).to(torch.int32)
+    kmax = min(nK, max(8, (int(cnt.max()) + 7) // 8 * 8))
+    order = torch.argsort(adj.to(torch.int8), dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
+    idx = order[..., :kmax].to(torch.int32)
+    idx = torch.where(torch.arange(kmax).view(1, 1, kmax) < cnt.unsqueeze(-1), idx, torch.zeros_like(idx))
+    assert int(cnt.min()) >= 1, "a query block attends no KV block"
+    return idx.unsqueeze(0).contiguous(), cnt.unsqueeze(0).contiguous()
+
+
+def _groups_to_blocks(group_valid: Sequence[int]) -> Tuple[List[List[int]], List[int]]:
+    blocks_of_group: List[List[int]] = []
+    sizes: List[int] = []
+    for v in group_valid:
+        ids = []
+        v = int(v)
+        while v > 0:
+            take = min(BLOCK, v)
+            ids.append(len(sizes))
+            sizes.append(take)
+            v -= take
+        blocks_of_group.append(ids)
+    return blocks_of_group, sizes
+
+
+def _group_mask_to_layout(name: str, desc: str, H: int, group_valid: Sequence[int], group_adj: torch.Tensor, meta: Dict) -> Layout:
+    blocks_of_group, sizes = _groups_to_blocks(group_valid)
+    nB, G = len(sizes), len(group_valid)
+    blk_group = torch.empty(nB, dtype=torch.long)
+    for g, ids in enumerate(blocks_of_group):
+        for b in ids:
+            blk_group[b] = g
+    if group_adj.shape[0] == 1 and H > 1:
+        group_adj = group_adj.expand(H, G, G)
+    adj = group_adj.cpu()[:, blk_group][:, :, blk_group]
+    idx, cnt = _adj_to_q2k(adj)
+    return Layout(name, desc, H, idx, cnt, torch.tensor(sizes, dtype=torch.int32), dict(meta, num_groups=G))
+
+
+def _ceil_sizes(dim_len: int, tile: int) -> List[int]:
+    n = math.ceil(dim_len / tile)
+    out = [tile] * n
+    out[-1] = dim_len - (n - 1) * tile
+    return out
+
+
+def _tile_valid_counts(canvas: Tuple[int, int, int], tile: Tuple[int, int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Valid voxels per 3D tile in (t, h, w) tile order; matches FastVideo's
+    construct_variable_block_sizes and the HunyuanVideo-1.5 zero padding."""
+    ts = [np.asarray(_ceil_sizes(c, t)) for c, t in zip(canvas, tile)]
+    return (ts[0][:, None, None] * ts[1][None, :, None] * ts[2][None, None, :]).reshape(-1)
+
+
+def _sta_window_mask(ntiles: Tuple[int, int, int], win: Tuple[int, int, int]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Clamped-centre 3D window over tiles (hyvideo create_sta_3d_mask_optimize)."""
+    nt, nh, nw = ntiles
+    i = np.arange(nt * nh * nw)
+    qt, qh, qw = i // (nh * nw), (i % (nh * nw)) // nw, i % nw
+    ct = np.clip(qt, win[0] // 2, (nt - 1) - win[0] // 2)
+    ch = np.clip(qh, win[1] // 2, (nh - 1) - win[1] // 2)
+    cw = np.clip(qw, win[2] // 2, (nw - 1) - win[2] // 2)
+    m = np.abs(ct[:, None] - qt[None, :]) <= win[0] // 2
+    m &= np.abs(ch[:, None] - qh[None, :]) <= win[1] // 2
+    m &= np.abs(cw[:, None] - qw[None, :]) <= win[2] // 2
+    return torch.from_numpy(m)
+
+
+def _topk_mask(H: int, G: int, k: int, gen: torch.Generator) -> torch.Tensor:
+    scores = torch.randn(H, G, G, generator=gen)
+    top = scores.topk(min(k, G), dim=-1).indices
+    m = torch.zeros(H, G, G, dtype=torch.bool)
+    m.scatter_(-1, top, True)
+    return m
+
+
+HY15 = dict(tile=(6, 8, 8), win=(3, 3, 3), topk=64, vae_t=4, vae_s=16)
+STA_WINDOWS_HY = [(3, 3, 3), (3, 3, 5), (3, 6, 10), (5, 6, 10), (3, 3, 3), (3, 6, 10), (5, 6, 10), (3, 3, 5)]
+
+
+def ssta_hunyuan(
+    width_px: int,
+    height_px: int,
+    frames: int,
+    H: int = 16,
+    seed: int = 0,
+    text_valid: int = 356,
+    topk: Optional[int] = None,
+    windows: Optional[Sequence[Tuple[int, int, int]]] = None,
+    name: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Layout:
+    cfg = HY15
+    t = (frames - 1) // cfg["vae_t"] + 1
+    h, w = height_px // cfg["vae_s"], width_px // cfg["vae_s"]
+    tile, win = cfg["tile"], cfg["win"]
+    if topk is None:
+        topk = cfg["topk"] if t > 31 else cfg["topk"] // 2
+    ntiles = tuple(math.ceil(c / s) for c, s in zip((t, h, w), tile))
+    Gv = int(np.prod(ntiles))
+    tile_tokens = int(np.prod(tile))
+    text_tiles = math.ceil(text_valid / tile_tokens)
+    text_valid_per_tile = [tile_tokens] * text_tiles
+    text_valid_per_tile[-1] = text_valid - tile_tokens * (text_tiles - 1)
+    G = Gv + text_tiles
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    if windows is None:
+        sta = _sta_window_mask(ntiles, win).unsqueeze(0)
+    else:
+        sta = torch.stack([_sta_window_mask(ntiles, tuple(windows[hh % len(windows)])) for hh in range(H)])
+    adj = torch.zeros(H, G, G, dtype=torch.bool)
+    adj[:, :Gv, :Gv] = sta if sta.shape[0] == H else sta.expand(H, Gv, Gv)
+    if topk > 0:
+        adj[:, :Gv, :Gv] |= _topk_mask(H, Gv, topk, gen)
+    adj[:, :, Gv:] = True  # video rows attend the text tiles
+    adj[:, Gv:, :] = True  # text rows attend everything
+    group_valid = list(map(int, _tile_valid_counts((t, h, w), tile))) + text_valid_per_tile
+    desc = (
+        f"{width_px}x{height_px} {frames}f: latent {t}x{h}x{w} -> tiles {ntiles} of {tile}"
+        + (f", top-{topk}/head" if topk else "")
+        + f", {text_valid} text tokens"
+    )
+    return _group_mask_to_layout(name or f"ssta_hy15_{height_px}p_{frames}f", desc, H, group_valid, adj, dict(latent=(t, h, w), tile=tile, topk=topk))
+
+
+def sta_hunyuan(H: int = 24, frames: int = 117, text_valid: int = 256, seed: int = 0) -> Layout:
+    return ssta_hunyuan(1280, 720, frames, H=H, seed=seed, text_valid=text_valid, topk=0, windows=STA_WINDOWS_HY, name=f"sta_hy_720p_{frames}f")
+
+
+def vsa_wan(width_px: int, height_px: int, frames: int, tile: Tuple[int, int, int] = (4, 8, 8), sparsity: float = 0.875, H: int = 12, seed: int = 0) -> Layout:
+    t = (frames - 1) // 4 + 1
+    h, w = height_px // 16, width_px // 16
+    ntiles = tuple(math.ceil(c / s) for c, s in zip((t, h, w), tile))
+    G = int(np.prod(ntiles))
+    topk = max(1, min(math.ceil((1 - sparsity) * G), G))
+    adj = _topk_mask(H, G, topk, torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed))
+    tile_tokens = int(np.prod(tile))
+    desc = f"Wan2.1 {width_px}x{height_px} {frames}f: latent {t}x{h}x{w} -> tiles {ntiles} of {tile}, sparsity {sparsity} (top-{topk}/{G} per head)"
+    return _group_mask_to_layout(
+        f"vsa_wan_{height_px}p_{frames}f_t{tile_tokens}",
+        desc,
+        H,
+        list(map(int, _tile_valid_counts((t, h, w), tile))),
+        adj,
+        dict(latent=(t, h, w), tile=tile, sparsity=sparsity),
+    )
+
+
+def build(spec: str) -> Layout:
+    """``ssta:WxHxF[:heads]`` | ``sta[:heads]`` | ``vsa:WxHxF:tile_tokens[:sparsity[:heads]]``."""
+    kind, *rest = spec.split(":")
+    if kind == "ssta":
+        w, h, f = map(int, rest[0].split("x"))
+        return ssta_hunyuan(w, h, f, H=int(rest[1]) if len(rest) > 1 else 16)
+    if kind == "sta":
+        return sta_hunyuan(H=int(rest[0]) if rest else 24)
+    if kind == "vsa":
+        w, h, f = map(int, rest[0].split("x"))
+        tile = {64: (4, 4, 4), 256: (4, 8, 8), 128: (2, 8, 8)}[int(rest[1]) if len(rest) > 1 else 256]
+        sparsity = float(rest[2]) if len(rest) > 2 else 0.875
+        return vsa_wan(w, h, f, tile=tile, sparsity=sparsity, H=int(rest[3]) if len(rest) > 3 else 12)
+    raise ValueError(spec)
+
+
+# The layouts the benchmark runs by default: HunyuanVideo-1.5 SSTA at two
+# resolutions and two lengths, Sliding Tile Attention, FastVideo VSA with
+# (4,4,4) and (4,8,8) cubes.  Padding ranges from 0.7% to 59%.
+BENCHMARK_LAYOUTS = [
+    "ssta:848x480x121:16",
+    "ssta:848x480x241:16",
+    "ssta:1280x720x121:16",
+    "ssta:1280x720x241:16",

+    "vsa:1280x720x81:256:0.875:40",
+    "vsa:1280x720x81:64:0.875:40",
+]

+
+`kpage=True` on `block_sparse_attention_forward` and

+happens when a 3D video latent is flattened and `block_sizes` marks the rows
+past each block's content. The base kernels load and compute every selected
+block as a full 128-row tile and mask the padding; KPage splits each selected
+K/V block into 16-row pages and gathers only the valid pages, from any blocks,
+into the same 128-row MMA tile during the TMA load. A block with `v` valid
+rows then costs `16 * ceil(v / 16)` rows instead of 128. Query blocks with at
+most 64 valid rows (see `q_block_sizes` below) run on an M64 x N256 kernel,
+the others on M128 x N128. Backward packs K/V pages into owner tiles the same
+way and walks the union of their Q pages with a per-step page-pair mask, so
+`block_sizes` is supported in backward on this path.

+`kpage=True` computes the same function as the base path with the same
+arguments (`block_sizes` masks keys, every query row is valid) and builds
+the page layout on the call. `kpage_prepare_layout` builds a `KPageLayout`
+once from the metadata so repeated calls with the same sparse pattern (every

+"""KPage entry points behind the ``kpage=`` argument of the BSA wrappers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple, Union
+
+import torch
+
+from .kpage._layout import KPageLayout
+
+KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL = (4, 6, 2)
+
+
+def _require_cutedsl() -> None:
+    from ._interface import _cutlass_dsl_version
+
+    version = _cutlass_dsl_version()
+    if version < KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "KPage block-sparse attention requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl>="
+            + ".".join(map(str, KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL))
+            + "; found "
+            + ".".join(map(str, version))
+            + ". The other BSA paths remain available."
+        )
+
+
+def _normalize_metadata(
+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q_block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    num_kv_blocks: Optional[int],
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Expand the BSA metadata to the four tensors the layout builder consumes.
+
+    The batch is folded into the head dimension: the layout tables are per
+    (batch, head) and ``block_sizes`` is shared across the batch anyway.
+    """
+    if q2k_block_index.ndim != 4 or q2k_block_index.dtype != torch.int32 or not q2k_block_index.is_cuda:
+        raise ValueError("q2k_block_index must be a rank-4 int32 CUDA tensor")
+    if not q2k_block_index.is_contiguous() or (q2k_block_nums is not None and not q2k_block_nums.is_contiguous()):
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires contiguous q2k_block_index and q2k_block_nums")
+    batch, heads, num_q_blocks, capacity = q2k_block_index.shape
+    q2k_block_index = q2k_block_index.view(1, batch * heads, num_q_blocks, capacity)
+    if q2k_block_nums is None:
+        if block_sparse_num is None:
+            block_sparse_num = capacity
+        if not 1 <= block_sparse_num <= capacity:
+            raise ValueError(f"block_sparse_num must be in [1, {capacity}], got {block_sparse_num}")
+        q2k_block_nums = torch.full((1, batch * heads, num_q_blocks), block_sparse_num, dtype=torch.int32, device=q2k_block_index.device)
+    else:
+        q2k_block_nums = q2k_block_nums.view(1, batch * heads, num_q_blocks)
+    if block_sizes is None:
+        if num_kv_blocks is None:
+            num_kv_blocks = num_q_blocks
+        block_sizes = torch.full((num_kv_blocks,), 128, dtype=torch.int32, device=q2k_block_index.device)
+    elif block_sizes.ndim != 1:
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage takes block_sizes of shape (num_kv_blocks,)")
+    elif num_kv_blocks is not None and block_sizes.numel() != num_kv_blocks:
+        raise ValueError(f"block_sizes has {block_sizes.numel()} entries, seqlen_k spans {num_kv_blocks} KV blocks")
+    if q_block_sizes is None:
+        q_block_sizes = torch.full((num_q_blocks,), 128, dtype=torch.int32, device=q2k_block_index.device)
+    return q2k_block_index, q2k_block_nums, block_sizes, q_block_sizes
+
+
+def _metadata_source(q2k_block_index, block_sparse_num, block_sizes, q2k_block_nums) -> tuple:
+    """Identity of the metadata arguments: storage, shape and strides of each tensor.
+
+    A layout remembers what it was built from so a call that passes it with
+    other metadata is rejected instead of silently running the wrong pattern.
+    The tensors themselves are kept alive by the layout, so storage addresses
+    cannot be recycled behind the check.
+    """
+
+    def ident(t):
+        return None if t is None else (t.data_ptr(), tuple(t.shape), tuple(t.stride()), t)
+
+    # block_sparse_num only matters with fixed counts, and None means "the whole row"
+    if q2k_block_nums is not None:
+        block_sparse_num = None
+    elif block_sparse_num is None:
+        block_sparse_num = int(q2k_block_index.shape[-1])
+    return (ident(q2k_block_index), block_sparse_num, ident(block_sizes), ident(q2k_block_nums))
+
+
+def _same_source(a: tuple, b: tuple) -> bool:
+    return all(x[:3] == y[:3] if isinstance(x, tuple) and isinstance(y, tuple) else x == y for x, y in zip(a, b))
+
+
+def prepare_layout(
+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    q_block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    seqlen_q: Optional[int] = None,
+    seqlen_k: Optional[int] = None,
+    validate: bool,
+    allow_empty_block_nums: bool = False,
+    bwd_kv_groups: Optional[int],
+    with_backward: bool = False,

+    _require_cutedsl()

+    if major != 10:
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"kpage requires an SM100/SM103 GPU, found SM{major}{minor}")

+    )
+    from .kpage._layout import prepare_layout as _prepare

+    with torch.cuda.device(idx.device):
+        layout = _prepare(
+            idx,
+            nums,
+            kv_sizes,
+            q_sizes,
+            seqlen_q=seqlen_q,
+            seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+            validate=validate,
+            allow_empty_block_nums=allow_empty_block_nums,
+            bwd_kv_groups=bwd_kv_groups,
+            source=source,
+        )
+        if with_backward:
+            layout.build_backward()

+
+
+def resolve_layout(
+    kpage: Union[bool, KPageLayout],
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    arch: int,
+    sparse_block_size: int,
+    allow_empty_block_nums: bool,
+    extra: Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], ...] = (),
+) -> KPageLayout:
+    """Check the KPage contract for one call (tensors as BHSD views) and return the layout to run."""
+    _require_cutedsl()
+    if arch // 10 != 10:  # the kernels are validated on SM100/SM103 only
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"kpage requires an SM100/SM103 GPU, found SM{arch}")
+    if sparse_block_size != 128:
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires sparse_block_size=128")
+    if q.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires BF16 q, k, and v")
+    if k.shape != v.shape or q.shape[0] != k.shape[0] or q.shape[-1] != k.shape[-1]:
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires k and v of one shape with the batch and head_dim of q")
+    batch, heads, seqlen_q, head_dim = q.shape
+    seqlen_k = k.shape[2]
+    if heads % k.shape[1]:
+        raise ValueError("the number of query heads must be divisible by the number of KV heads")
+    if head_dim != 128:
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires head_dim=128")
+    for name, t in (("q", q), ("k", k), ("v", v), *zip(("do_tensor", "o_tensor", "lse_tensor", "dq_tensor", "dk_tensor", "dv_tensor"), extra)):
+        if t is not None:
+            folded = _fold(t, name)
+            if not (folded.is_contiguous() or (folded.ndim == 4 and folded.transpose(1, 2).is_contiguous())):
+                raise NotImplementedError(f"kpage requires a compact BHSD or BSHD {name}, got strides {tuple(t.stride())}")
+
+    if isinstance(kpage, KPageLayout):
+        if kpage.device != q.device:
+            raise ValueError(f"the KPageLayout was built on {kpage.device}, q is on {q.device}")
+        if (kpage.num_heads, kpage.seqlen_q, kpage.seqlen_k) != (batch * heads, seqlen_q, seqlen_k):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"the KPageLayout describes {kpage.num_heads} (batch x heads) x {kpage.seqlen_q} query / {kpage.seqlen_k} key tokens, "
+                f"the call has {batch} x {heads} x {seqlen_q} / {seqlen_k}"
+            )
+        if not _same_source(kpage._source, _metadata_source(q2k_block_index, block_sparse_num, block_sizes, q2k_block_nums)):
+            raise ValueError("the KPageLayout was built from different sparse metadata; pass the same tensors, rebuild it, or use kpage=True")
+        return kpage
+    if kpage is not True:
+        raise TypeError(f"kpage must be False, True, or a KPageLayout, got {type(kpage).__name__}")
+    return prepare_layout(
+        q2k_block_index,
+        block_sparse_num,
+        block_sizes,
+        q2k_block_nums,
+        seqlen_q=seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+        validate=True,
+        allow_empty_block_nums=allow_empty_block_nums,
+        bwd_kv_groups=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _fold(t: Optional[torch.Tensor], name: str = "tensor") -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """[B, H, ...] -> [1, B * H, ...] view; the kernels run a batch as batch x heads."""
+    if t is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return t.view(1, t.shape[0] * t.shape[1], *t.shape[2:])
+    except RuntimeError:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"kpage runs a batch as batch x heads and needs {name} to be viewable as [1, batch * heads, ...]; a BSHD batch > 1 is not"
+        ) from None
+
+
+def forward(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor, layout_obj: KPageLayout, softmax_scale: Optional[float]):
+    from .kpage import _interface
+
+    batch, heads = q.shape[:2]
+    out, lse = _interface.forward(_fold(q), _fold(k), _fold(v), layout_obj, softmax_scale)
+    return out.view(batch, heads, *out.shape[2:]), lse.view(batch, heads, lse.shape[2])
+
+
+def backward(
+    do: torch.Tensor,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    o: torch.Tensor,
+    lse: torch.Tensor,
+    layout_obj: KPageLayout,
+    softmax_scale: Optional[float],
+    dq: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    dk: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    dv: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+):
+    from .kpage import _interface
+
+    batch = q.shape[0]
+    grads = _interface.backward(_fold(do), _fold(q), _fold(k), _fold(v), _fold(o), _fold(lse), layout_obj, softmax_scale, _fold(dq), _fold(dk), _fold(dv))
+    return tuple(g.view(batch, g.shape[1] // batch, *g.shape[2:]) for g in grads)

+        of the 16-row page view, whose whole-page TMA boxes are a few percent faster."""

+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # (b_k, h_k, s_k, dv), partial Page16 suffixes zero

+        2. Validation of tensor shapes and data types

+        )
+
+        tma_atom_O, mO = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+            tma_store_op,
+            mO,
+            cute.select(sO_layout, mode=[0, 1]),
+            self.epi_tile,
+        )
+        TileScheduler = KPagePersistentTileScheduler
+        tile_sched_args = TileSchedulerArguments(
+            cute.size(mBlockNums.shape[2]),  # 2 * num_q_blocks: the stride of the work IDs and walk tables, not ceil(seqlen_q / 64)
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[2]),
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[3]),
+            num_splits,
+            cute.size(mK.shape[0]),
+            mQ.shape[1],
+            self.head_dim_v_padded,
+            total_q=cute.size(mQ.shape[0]) * cute.size(mQ.shape[3]),
+            tile_shape_mn=self.cta_tiler[:2],
+            qhead_per_kvhead_packgqa=1,
+            element_size=self.k_dtype.width // 8,
+            is_persistent=True,
+            is_split_kv=False,
+        )
+        tile_sched_params = TileScheduler.to_underlying_arguments(
+            tile_sched_args,
+            scheduling_mode=self.scheduling_mode,
+            num_work=cute.size(mWorkIndices),
+        )
+        self.tile_scheduler_cls = TileScheduler
+        grid_dim = TileScheduler.get_grid_shape(tile_sched_params)
+
+        sO_size = cute.cosize(sO_layout)
+        sQ_size = cute.cosize(sQ_layout)
+        # K/V storage is reused by the correction exchange and O epilogue.
+        sO_size_in_k_elements = (sO_size * self.o_dtype.width + self.k_dtype.width - 1) // self.k_dtype.width
+        sKV_size = max(
+            cute.cosize(sK_layout),
+            self.epi_sO_input_offset + sO_size_in_k_elements,
+        )
+
+        clc_response_size = self.sched_stages * 4
+        clc_mbar_size = self.sched_stages * 2
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class SharedStorage:
+            # m_barriers for pipelines
+            mbar_load_Q: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.q_stage * 2]
+            mbar_load_KV: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.kv_stage * 2]
+            mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_P_full_lastsplit: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_full: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_softmax_stats: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_epi: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            # Tmem holding buffer
+            tmem_holding_buf: Int32
+            # Per warp-pair reduction barriers for correction exchange.
+            reduce_mbar: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, 2]
+            # Smem tensors
+            # store row max and row sum
+            sScale: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, self.s_stage * self.stats_stride * 2]
+            oStats: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, 4 * 32 * 2]
+            # CLC buffers (mbarriers + response storage)
+            clc_mbar_ptr: cute.struct.MemRange[cutlass.Int64, clc_mbar_size]
+            clc_response: cute.struct.Align[
+                cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, clc_response_size],
+                16,
+            ]
+            sQ: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.q_dtype, sQ_size], self.buffer_align_bytes]
+            sK: cute.struct.Align[
+                cute.struct.MemRange[self.k_dtype, sKV_size],
+                self.buffer_align_bytes,
+            ]
+
+        self.shared_storage = SharedStorage
+
+        softmax_scale_log2, softmax_scale = utils.compute_softmax_scale_log2(softmax_scale)
+        fastdiv_mods = None
+
+        # Launch the kernel synchronously
+        self.kernel(
+            mQ,
+            mK,
+            mV,
+            mO,
+            mLSE,
+            tma_atom_Q,
+            tma_atom_K,
+            tma_atom_V,
+            tma_atom_O,
+            softmax_scale_log2,
+            softmax_scale,
+            sQ_layout,
+            sQ_tma_layout,
+            sK_layout,
+            sK_tma_layout,
+            tP_layout,
+            sV_layout,
+            sV_tma_layout,
+            sO_layout,
+            tiled_mma_qk,
+            tiled_mma_pv,
+            tile_sched_params,
+            mPageTable,
+            mMaskTable,
+            mTileOffsets,
+            mFullIterCounts,
+            mWorkIndices,
+            mBlockNums,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=grid_dim,
+            block=[self.threads_per_cta, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+            min_blocks_per_mp=1,
+        )
+
+    #  GPU device kernel
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,  # (s_q, d, h, b)
+        mK: cute.Tensor,  # Rank-5 Int64 or rank-6 sparse-block view
+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # Rank-5 Int64 or rank-6 sparse-block view
+        mO: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        tma_atom_Q: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_K: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_V: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_O: cute.CopyAtom,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        softmax_scale: Float32 | None,
+        sQ_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sQ_tma_layout: Optional[cute.ComposedLayout],
+        sK_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sK_tma_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tP_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sV_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sV_tma_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sO_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tiled_mma_qk: cute.TiledMma,
+        tiled_mma_pv: cute.TiledMma,
+        tile_sched_params: ParamsBase,
+        mPageTable: cute.Tensor,
+        mMaskTable: cute.Tensor,
+        mTileOffsets: cute.Tensor,
+        mFullIterCounts: cute.Tensor,
+        mWorkIndices: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mBlockNums: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """The device kernel implementation of the Fused Multi-Head Attention.
+
+        This kernel coordinates multiple specialized warps to perform different phases of the FMHA computation:
+        1. Load warp: Loads Q, K, V data from global memory to shared memory using TMA
+        2. MMA warp: Performs matrix multiplications (Q*K^T and P*V)
+        3. Softmax warps: Compute softmax normalization on attention scores
+        4. Correction warps: Apply adjustments to intermediate results
+        5. Epilogue warp: Handles final output transformation and storage
+
+        The kernel implements a complex pipeline with overlapping computation and memory operations,
+        using tensor memory access (TMA) for efficient data loading, warp specialization for different
+        computation phases, and optional attention masking.
+        """
+
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+
+        # Prefetch tma descriptor
+        if warp_idx == 0:
+            for tma_atom in (tma_atom_Q, tma_atom_K, tma_atom_V, tma_atom_O):
+                if const_expr(tma_atom is not None):
+                    cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(tma_atom)
+
+        # Alloc
+        smem = SmemAllocator()
+        storage = smem.allocate(self.shared_storage)
+
+        tmem_alloc_barrier = _SubsetNamedBarrier(
+            barrier_id=int(NamedBarrierFwdSm100.TmemPtr),
+            num_threads=cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len((self.mma_warp_id, *self.softmax0_warp_ids, *self.softmax1_warp_ids, *self.correction_warp_ids)),
+        )
+        # Tensor memory allocator
+        tmem = TmemAllocator(
+            storage.tmem_holding_buf,
+            barrier_for_retrieve=tmem_alloc_barrier,
+            allocator_warp_id=self.mma_warp_id,
+        )
+
+        ThreadCooperativeGroup = partial(pipeline.CooperativeGroup, pipeline.Agent.Thread)
+        mma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len([self.mma_warp_id]))
+        q_tma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(1)
+        kv_tma_warps = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len(self.load_warp_ids))
+        softmax_warps = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        softmax_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.correction_warp_ids))
+        softmax_correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids + self.correction_warp_ids))
+        epilogue_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.epilogue_warp_ids))
+        pipeline_q = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_Q.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.q_stage,
+            producer_group=q_tma_warp,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["Q"],
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_kv = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_KV.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.kv_stage,
+            producer_group=kv_tma_warps,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["K"] // len(self.load_warp_ids),
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # This pipeline is not the typical producer-consumer pipeline. The "producer" mma warp
+        # uses it to signal that S is ready, and the softmax threads wait for S to be ready.
+        # When softmax threads write P to tmem and the correction threads have rescaled O, they
+        # signal as "consumer". The mma warp then waits for that signal to do the P @ V gemm.
+        pipeline_s_p_o = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=mma_warp,
+            consumer_group=softmax_correction_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_p_lastsplit = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsyncUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_P_full_lastsplit.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=softmax_warps,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # MMA warp uses this to signal to the correction warps that O is ready.
+        pipeline_o_acc = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_O_full.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=mma_warp,
+            consumer_group=correction_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_sm_stats = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_softmax_stats.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=softmax_threads,
+            consumer_group=correction_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # Should put the NamedBarrier inside the pipeline class so we'll just have pipeline_sm_stats
+        sm_stats_barrier = _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=int(NamedBarrierFwdSm100.SoftmaxStatsW0), num_threads=cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * 2)
+        reduce_mbar_ptr = storage.reduce_mbar.data_ptr()
+        pipeline_o_epi = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_O_epi.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=correction_threads,
+            consumer_group=epilogue_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+
+        if warp_idx == 0:
+            with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(reduce_mbar_ptr + 0, cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * 2)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(reduce_mbar_ptr + 1, cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * 2)
+
+        # Fence pipeline barrier initialization before any warp uses it.
+        pipeline_init_arrive(is_relaxed=True)
+
+        #  Generate smem tensor Q/K/V/O
+        # (MMA, MMA_Q, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        sQ = storage.sQ.get_tensor(sQ_layout.outer, swizzle=sQ_layout.inner)
+        sKV_ptr = storage.sK.data_ptr()
+        k_dim_half = self.head_dim_padded // 2
+        v_dim_part = self.head_dim_v_padded // 2
+        sK_page_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(
+            sK_tma_layout.inner,
+            0,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (PAGE, (k_dim_half, 2)),
+                stride=(k_dim_half, (1, self.n_block_size * k_dim_half)),
+            ),
+        )
+        sV_page_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(
+            sV_tma_layout.inner,
+            0,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                ((v_dim_part, 2), PAGE),
+                stride=((1, v_dim_part * self.sparse_block_size), v_dim_part),
+            ),
+        )
+        # (MMA, MMA_K, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        sK = storage.sK.get_tensor(sK_layout.outer, swizzle=sK_layout.inner)
+        # (MMA, MMA_K, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        # Strip swizzle info to reuse smem
+        sV = cute.make_tensor(cute.recast_ptr(sKV_ptr, sV_layout.inner), sV_layout.outer)
+        # Match the C++ blk64 SharedStorage union: epilogue exchange/sO reuses
+        # the large KV buffer after the mainloop has finished consuming it.
+        sO = cute.make_tensor(
+            cute.recast_ptr(sKV_ptr + self.epi_sO_input_offset, sO_layout.inner, self.o_dtype),
+            sO_layout.outer,
+        )
+
+        sScale = storage.sScale.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(self.s_stage * self.stats_stride * 2))
+        oStats = storage.oStats.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(4 * 32 * 2))
+        oExchange = cute.make_tensor(
+            cute.recast_ptr(sKV_ptr, dtype=Float32),
+            cute.make_layout(self.epi_exchange_f32_count),
+        )
+
+        thr_mma_qk = tiled_mma_qk.get_slice(0)
+        thr_mma_pv = tiled_mma_pv.get_slice(0)
+
+        pv_acc_shape = thr_mma_pv.partition_shape_C(self.mma_tiler_pv[:2])
+        tOtO_base = thr_mma_pv.make_fragment_C(pv_acc_shape)
+        tOtO = cute.make_tensor(
+            tOtO_base.iterator + self.tmem_o_offset[0],
+            cute.append(
+                tOtO_base.layout,
+                cute.make_layout(
+                    (self.s_stage,),
+                    stride=(self.tmem_o_offset[1] - self.tmem_o_offset[0],),
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+        p_frag_shape = thr_mma_pv.partition_shape_A((self.m_block_size, self.kv_mma_k))
+        tOrP_base = thr_mma_pv.make_fragment_A(p_frag_shape)
+        # Need to multiply by width ratio bc tP is in v_dtype but tmem offsets are in FP32
+        tP_width_ratio = Float32.width // self.v_dtype.width
+        # Need to adjust the stage stride manually since the two stages aren't contiguous in tmem
+        tP_stage_stride = (self.tmem_p_offset[1] - self.tmem_p_offset[0]) * tP_width_ratio
+        tOrP = cute.make_tensor(
+            tOrP_base.iterator + self.tmem_p_offset[0] * tP_width_ratio,
+            cute.append(tOrP_base.layout, cute.make_layout((self.s_stage,), stride=(tP_stage_stride,))),
+        )
+        SeqlenInfoCls = partial(
+            SeqlenInfoQK.create,
+            seqlen_q_static=mQ.shape[0],
+            seqlen_k_static=mK.shape[0],
+        )
+        clc_response_ptr = storage.clc_response.data_ptr()
+        clc_mbar_ptr = storage.clc_mbar_ptr.data_ptr()
+        clc_pipeline_producer_group = cutlass_pipeline.CooperativeGroup(cutlass_pipeline.Agent.Thread)
+        num_clc_consumer_warps = self.threads_per_cta // cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+        clc_pipeline_consumer_group = cutlass_pipeline.CooperativeGroup(
+            cutlass_pipeline.Agent.Thread,
+            cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * num_clc_consumer_warps,
+        )
+        clc_pipeline = cutlass_pipeline.PipelineClcFetchAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=clc_mbar_ptr,
+            num_stages=self.sched_stages,
+            producer_group=clc_pipeline_producer_group,
+            consumer_group=clc_pipeline_consumer_group,
+            tx_count=16,
+        )
+        tile_scheduler = self.tile_scheduler_cls.create(
+            tile_sched_params,
+            clc_response_ptr=clc_response_ptr,
+            work_indices=mWorkIndices,
+        )
+        clc_consumer_state = cutlass_pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+            cutlass_pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer,
+            self.sched_stages,
+        )
+        tile_scheduler.set_clc_pipeline(clc_pipeline, clc_consumer_state)
+
+        # Synchronize the CTA before tensor memory allocation.
+        pipeline_init_wait()
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  EMPTY / CLC SCHEDULER WARP
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  LOAD
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.load_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx <= self.load_warp_ids[-1]:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            self.load(
+                thr_mma_qk,
+                thr_mma_pv,
+                mQ,
+                mK,
+                mV,
+                sQ,
+                sKV_ptr,
+                sQ_tma_layout,
+                sK_page_layout,
+                sV_page_layout,
+                tma_atom_Q,
+                tma_atom_K,
+                tma_atom_V,
+                pipeline_q,
+                pipeline_kv,
+                clc_pipeline,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                mPageTable,
+                mTileOffsets,
+                mBlockNums,
+            )
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  MMA
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx == self.mma_warp_id:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            # Alloc tensor memory buffer
+            tmem.allocate(cute.arch.get_max_tmem_alloc_cols("sm_100"))
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            self.mma(
+                tiled_mma_qk,
+                tiled_mma_pv,
+                sQ,
+                sK,
+                sV,
+                tOtO,
+                tOrP,
+                pipeline_q,
+                pipeline_kv,
+                pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_lastsplit,
+                pipeline_o_acc,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                mBlockNums,
+            )
+            # Dealloc the tensor memory buffer
+            tmem.relinquish_alloc_permit()
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()
+            tmem.free(tmem_ptr)
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Epilogue
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.epilogue_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx <= self.epilogue_warp_ids[-1]:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            self.epilogue_s2g(
+                mO,
+                sO,
+                tma_atom_O,
+                pipeline_o_epi,
+                SeqlenInfoCls,
+                tile_scheduler,
+            )
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Softmax
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx <= self.softmax1_warp_ids[-1]:
+            # increase register after decreasing
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_increase(self.num_regs_softmax)
+            # sync with mma warp before retrieving tmem ptr
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            softmax_loop = partial(
+                self.softmax_loop,
+                softmax_scale_log2=softmax_scale_log2,
+                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                sScale=sScale,
+                mLSE=mLSE,
+                pipeline_s_p_o=pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_lastsplit=pipeline_p_lastsplit,
+                pipeline_sm_stats=pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier=sm_stats_barrier,
+                tile_scheduler=tile_scheduler,
+                mMaskTable=mMaskTable,
+                mTileOffsets=mTileOffsets,
+                mFullIterCounts=mFullIterCounts,
+                mBlockNums=mBlockNums,
+            )
+
+            # Keep stage constexpr, matching the C++ template<int Stage> path.
+            if warp_idx < self.softmax1_warp_ids[0]:
+                softmax_loop(stage=0)
+            if warp_idx < self.correction_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx >= self.softmax1_warp_ids[0]:
+                softmax_loop(stage=1)
+
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive()
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Correction
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.correction_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx < self.mma_warp_id:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_correction)
+            # sync with mma warp before retrieving tmem ptr
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            self.correction_loop(
+                thr_mma_pv,
+                tOtO,
+                sScale,
+                mLSE,
+                sO,
+                pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_o_acc,
+                pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier,
+                reduce_mbar_ptr,
+                pipeline_o_epi,
+                softmax_scale_log2,
+                oStats,
+                oExchange,
+                SeqlenInfoCls,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                mBlockNums,
+            )
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive()
+
+        return
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def load(
+        self,
+        thr_mma_qk: cute.ThrMma,
+        thr_mma_pv: cute.ThrMma,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,
+        mK: cute.Tensor,
+        mV: cute.Tensor,
+        sQ: cute.Tensor,
+        sKV_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sQ_tma_layout: Optional[cute.ComposedLayout],
+        sK_page_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sV_page_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tma_atom_Q: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_K: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_V: cute.CopyAtom,
+        pipeline_q: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_kv: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        clc_pipeline: Optional[cutlass_pipeline.PipelineClcFetchAsync],
+        tile_scheduler: TileSchedulerProtocol,
+        mPageTable: cute.Tensor,
+        mTileOffsets: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockNums: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        num_load_threads = len(self.load_warp_ids) * cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % num_load_threads
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+        load_warp_rank = warp_idx - Int32(self.load_warp_ids[0])
+        q_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+        kv_producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.kv_stage)
+        clc_producer_state = cutlass_pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+            cutlass_pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer,
+            self.sched_stages,
+        )
+        tiler_gQ = ((self.mma_tiler_qk[0] * self.q_stage), self.head_dim_padded)
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+            mQ_cur = mQ[None, None, None, batch_idx][None, None, head_idx]
+            gQ = cute.local_tile(mQ_cur, tiler_gQ, (m_block, 0))
+            gQ = layout_utils.select(cute.flat_divide(gQ, (self.mma_tiler_qk[0],)), mode=[0, 2, 1])
+            tSgQ = thr_mma_qk.partition_A(gQ)
+            load_Q_fn, _, _ = copy_utils.tma_get_copy_fn(tma_atom_Q, 0, cute.make_layout(1), tSgQ, sQ)
+
+            head_idx_kv = head_idx // self.qhead_per_kvhead
+            if const_expr(self.tail_page):
+                gK_tma = cute.group_modes(cute.local_tile(mK[None, None, head_idx_kv, batch_idx], (PAGE, self.head_dim_padded), (None, 0)), 0, 2)
+                gV_tma = cute.group_modes(cute.local_tile(mV[None, None, head_idx_kv, batch_idx], (self.head_dim_v_padded, PAGE), (0, None)), 0, 2)
+            else:
+                gK_tma = cute.group_modes(mK[None, None, None, head_idx_kv, batch_idx], 0, 2)
+                gV_tma = cute.group_modes(mV[None, None, None, head_idx_kv, batch_idx], 0, 2)
+            block_iter_count = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+            process_tile = block_iter_count > Int32(0)
+            tile_base = mTileOffsets[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+
+            if process_tile:
+                # Match C++ blk64: issue the one-shot Q TMA first, then K[N-1]/K[N-2].
+                if warp_idx == self.load_warp_ids[0]:
+                    pipeline_q.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(0, q_producer_phase)
+                    tma_bar_ptr = pipeline_q.sync_object_full.get_barrier(0)
+                    load_Q_fn(src_idx=0, dst_idx=0, tma_bar_ptr=tma_bar_ptr)
+                q_producer_phase ^= 1
+
+                kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                    tma_atom_K,
+                    gK_tma,
+                    sKV_ptr,
+                    sK_page_layout,
+                    mPageTable,
+                    tile_base + (block_iter_count - 1) * 2,
+                    kv_producer_state,
+                    pipeline_kv,
+                    load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                    K_or_V="K",
+                )
+                # q_stage=1 intra-warp overlap
+                # Load order: Q, K[N-1], K[N-2], {V[N-1-i], K[N-3-i]}x(N-2), V[1], V[0]
+                block_loop_count = block_iter_count - 2
+
+                # Prologue: K[N-2]
+                kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                    tma_atom_K,
+                    gK_tma,
+                    sKV_ptr,
+                    sK_page_layout,
+                    mPageTable,
+                    tile_base + (block_iter_count - 2) * 2,
+                    kv_producer_state,
+                    pipeline_kv,
+                    load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                    K_or_V="K",
+                )
+
+                # Flat main loop: N-2 iterations, each loads V then K
+                for i in cutlass.range(block_loop_count, unroll=1):
+                    # V[N-1-i]: V for the block whose S was computed earlier
+                    kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                        tma_atom_V,
+                        gV_tma,
+                        sKV_ptr,
+                        sV_page_layout,
+                        mPageTable,
+                        tile_base + (block_iter_count - 1 - i) * 2,
+                        kv_producer_state,
+                        pipeline_kv,
+                        load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                        K_or_V="V",
+                    )
+                    # K[N-3-i]: K for the next QK GEMM
+                    kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                        tma_atom_K,
+                        gK_tma,
+                        sKV_ptr,
+                        sK_page_layout,
+                        mPageTable,
+                        tile_base + (block_iter_count - 3 - i) * 2,
+                        kv_producer_state,
+                        pipeline_kv,
+                        load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                        K_or_V="K",
+                    )
+
+                # Epilogue: last 2 V loads
+                kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                    tma_atom_V,
+                    gV_tma,
+                    sKV_ptr,
+                    sV_page_layout,
+                    mPageTable,
+                    tile_base + 2,
+                    kv_producer_state,
+                    pipeline_kv,
+                    K_or_V="V",
+                    load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                )
+                kv_producer_state = self.load_KV_pages(
+                    tma_atom_V,
+                    gV_tma,
+                    sKV_ptr,
+                    sV_page_layout,
+                    mPageTable,
+                    tile_base,
+                    kv_producer_state,
+                    pipeline_kv,
+                    K_or_V="V",
+                    load_warp_rank=load_warp_rank,
+                )
+
+            tile_scheduler.prefetch_next_work()
+            if load_warp_rank == Int32(0):
+                clc_pipeline.producer_acquire(clc_producer_state)
+                mbarrier_addr = clc_pipeline.producer_get_barrier(clc_producer_state)
+                tile_scheduler.advance_to_next_work(mbarrier_addr=mbarrier_addr)
+                clc_producer_state.advance()
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+            # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        pipeline_kv.producer_tail(kv_producer_state)
+        # This is equivalent to pipeline_q.producer_tail
+        if warp_idx == self.load_warp_ids[0]:
+            pipeline_q.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(self.q_stage - 1, q_producer_phase)
+        if load_warp_rank == Int32(0):
+            clc_pipeline.producer_tail(clc_producer_state)

+    @cute.jit
+    def mma(
+        self,
+        tiled_mma_qk: cute.TiledMma,
+        tiled_mma_pv: cute.TiledMma,
+        sQ: cute.Tensor,
+        sK: cute.Tensor,
+        sV: cute.Tensor,
+        tOtO: cute.Tensor,
+        tOrP: cute.Tensor,
+        pipeline_q: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_kv: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_p_lastsplit: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        tile_scheduler: TileSchedulerProtocol,
+        mBlockNums: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        tSrQ = tiled_mma_qk.make_fragment_A(sQ)
+        tSrK = tiled_mma_qk.make_fragment_B(sK)
+        tOrV = tiled_mma_pv.make_fragment_B(sV)
+        # q_stage=1: both stages use the same Q (intra-warp overlap across n_blocks)
+        tSrQ0 = tSrQ[None, None, None, 0]
+        sQ0 = sQ[None, None, None, 0]
+        tOrP0 = tOrP[None, None, None, 0]
+        tOrP1 = tOrP[None, None, None, 1]
+
+        qk_mma_op = tiled_mma_qk.op
+        pv_mma_op = tiled_mma_pv.op
+
+        mma_q_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        mma_kv_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.kv_stage)
+        q_full_mbar = Int32(pipeline_q.sync_object_full.get_barrier(0).toint())
+        spo_empty_mbar0 = Int32(pipeline_s_p_o.sync_object_empty.get_barrier(0).toint())
+        spo_empty_mbar1 = Int32(pipeline_s_p_o.sync_object_empty.get_barrier(1).toint())
+        # Pipeline s_p_o phases for stage 0 and stage 1.
+        # These phases must persist across tiles
+        # so that mbarrier phase stays in sync when block_iter_count varies.
+        phase_s0 = Int32(0)
+        phase_s1 = Int32(0)
+
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+
+            block_iter_count = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+            process_tile = block_iter_count > Int32(0)
+
+            if process_tile:
+                # ================================================================
+                # q_stage=1: intra-warp overlap across n_block direction
+                # Pipeline KV order: K0, K1, V0, K2, V1, K3, V2, ...
+                # GEMM order: S0=Q@K0, S1=Q@K1, {O0+=P0@V0, S0=Q@K2}, {O1+=P1@V1, S1=Q@K3}, ...
+                # ================================================================
+
+                # Prologue: wait Q0
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(q_full_mbar, mma_q_consumer_phase)
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                mma_q_consumer_phase ^= 1
+
+                # S0 = Q @ K0
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(
+                    Int32(pipeline_kv.sync_object_full.get_barrier(mma_kv_consumer_state.index).toint()),
+                    mma_kv_consumer_state.phase,
+                )
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                Ki_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                sK_cur = sK[None, None, None, Ki_index]
+                self.ws_qk_gemm(qk_mma_op, 0, tSrQ0, tSrK[None, None, None, Ki_index], sQ0, sK_cur)
+                pipeline_s_p_o.producer_commit_w_index(0)  # signal S0 ready
+                pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_consumer_state)
+                mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+
+                # S1 = Q @ K1
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(
+                    Int32(pipeline_kv.sync_object_full.get_barrier(mma_kv_consumer_state.index).toint()),
+                    mma_kv_consumer_state.phase,
+                )
+                bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                Ki_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                sK_cur = sK[None, None, None, Ki_index]
+                self.ws_qk_gemm(qk_mma_op, 1, tSrQ0, tSrK[None, None, None, Ki_index], sQ0, sK_cur)
+                pipeline_s_p_o.producer_commit_w_index(1)  # signal S1 ready
+                pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_consumer_state)
+                mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+
+                # Flat loop: N-2 iterations, alternating stage 0/1
+                block_loop_count = block_iter_count - 2
+                O_acc_s0 = False  # per-stage accumulate flags
+                O_acc_s1 = False
+                # Pre-declare loop variables for DSL type tracking
+                Vi_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                Ki_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                mma_kv_release_state = mma_kv_consumer_state.clone()
+                tOrVi = tOrV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                sV_cur = sV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                sK_cur = sK[None, None, None, Ki_index]
+
+                pair_count = block_loop_count // 2  # N even => block_loop_count = N-2 is even
+                for i in cutlass.range(pair_count, unroll=1):
+                    for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                        if const_expr(stage == 0):
+                            phase_cur, O_acc_cur = phase_s0, O_acc_s0
+                            spo_empty_mbar = spo_empty_mbar0
+                            tOrP_stage = tOrP0
+                        else:
+                            phase_cur, O_acc_cur = phase_s1, O_acc_s1
+                            spo_empty_mbar = spo_empty_mbar1
+                            tOrP_stage = tOrP1
+                        bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(spo_empty_mbar, phase_cur)
+                        # Wait V
+                        bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(
+                            Int32(pipeline_kv.sync_object_full.get_barrier(mma_kv_consumer_state.index).toint()),
+                            mma_kv_consumer_state.phase,
+                        )
+                        bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                        mma_kv_release_state = mma_kv_consumer_state.clone()
+                        Vi_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                        tOrVi = tOrV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                        sV_cur = sV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                        mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+                        self.ws_pv_gemm(
+                            pv_mma_op,
+                            stage,
+                            tOrP_stage,
+                            tOrVi,
+                            sV_cur,
+                            not O_acc_cur,
+                            phase_cur,
+                            pipeline_p_lastsplit,
+                        )
+                        pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_release_state)
+                        # Overlap the independent K wait with the preceding PV issue.
+                        bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(
+                            Int32(pipeline_kv.sync_object_full.get_barrier(mma_kv_consumer_state.index).toint()),
+                            mma_kv_consumer_state.phase,
+                        )
+                        bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                        Ki_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                        sK_cur = sK[None, None, None, Ki_index]
+                        self.ws_qk_gemm(
+                            qk_mma_op,
+                            stage,
+                            tSrQ0,
+                            tSrK[None, None, None, Ki_index],
+                            sQ0,
+                            sK_cur,
+                        )
+                        pipeline_s_p_o.producer_commit_w_index(stage)
+                        if const_expr(stage == 0):
+                            phase_s0 ^= 1
+                            O_acc_s0 = True
+                        else:
+                            phase_s1 ^= 1
+                            O_acc_s1 = True
+                        pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_consumer_state)
+                        mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+
+                # release Q0
+                pipeline_q.consumer_release_w_index(0)
+
+                # Epilogue: 2 PV GEMMs (N even: stage 0 first, stage 1 second)
+                for epi_stage_constexpr in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    if const_expr(epi_stage_constexpr == 0):
+                        epi_s, epi_p, epi_zi = 0, phase_s0, not O_acc_s0
+                        spo_empty_mbar = spo_empty_mbar0
+                        tOrP_epi = tOrP0
+                    else:
+                        epi_s, epi_p, epi_zi = 1, phase_s1, not O_acc_s1
+                        spo_empty_mbar = spo_empty_mbar1
+                        tOrP_epi = tOrP1
+                    bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(spo_empty_mbar, epi_p)
+                    bsa_fwd_helpers.mbar_wait(
+                        Int32(pipeline_kv.sync_object_full.get_barrier(mma_kv_consumer_state.index).toint()),
+                        mma_kv_consumer_state.phase,
+                    )
+                    bsa_fwd_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                    Vi_index = mma_kv_consumer_state.index
+                    tOrVi = tOrV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                    sV_cur = sV[None, None, None, Vi_index]
+                    self.ws_pv_gemm(
+                        pv_mma_op,
+                        epi_stage_constexpr,
+                        tOrP_epi,
+                        tOrVi,
+                        sV_cur,
+                        epi_zi,
+                        epi_p,
+                        pipeline_p_lastsplit,
+                    )
+                    pipeline_o_acc.producer_commit_w_index(epi_s)
+                    pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_consumer_state)
+                    mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+                # Epilogue did one acquire per stage; advance phases for next tile
+                phase_s0 ^= 1
+                phase_s1 ^= 1
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+        # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        # We don't need pipeline_s_p_o.producer_tail() since there's no dangling mbarrier at the end
+        # We don't need pipeline_o_acc.producer_tail() since we don't call
+        # pipeline_o_acc.producer_acquire() inside the loop.
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def ws_pv_gemm(
+        self,
+        pv_mma_op: cute.nvgpu.tcgen05.mma.MmaOp,
+        stage: int,
+        tCrP: cute.Tensor,
+        tCrV: cute.Tensor,
+        sV: cute.Tensor,
+        zero_init: bool | Boolean,
+        phase: Int32,
+        pipeline_p_lastsplit: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
